```yaml
name: Agentic Diagnostics - Safe Inputs & MCP Gateway

on:
  push:
    paths:
      - 'docs/src/content/docs/reference/safe-inputs-specification.md'
      - 'docs/public/schemas/safe-inputs-config.schema.json'
      - 'docs/**'
      - '.github/workflows/agentic-diagnostics.yml'
  pull_request:
    paths:
      - 'docs/src/content/docs/reference/safe-inputs-specification.md'
      - 'docs/public/schemas/safe-inputs-config.schema.json'
      - 'docs/**'
      - '.github/workflows/agentic-diagnostics.yml'

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  validate-specifications:
    name: Validate Safe Inputs & MCP Gateway Specs
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Setup Node.js for JSON Schema validation
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '20'

      - name: Install JSON Schema validator
        run: npm install ajv-cli

      - name: Validate Safe Inputs JSON Schema
        run: |
          # Validate the schema itself against Draft 7 meta-schema
          npx ajv validate -s docs/public/schemas/safe-inputs-config.schema.json -d docs/public/schemas/safe-inputs-config.schema.json --spec=draft7
          
          # Check for required fields in schema definition
          if ! grep -q '"oneOf"' docs/public/schemas/safe-inputs-config.schema.json; then
            echo "::error::Schema must contain 'oneOf' constraint for mutually exclusive implementations"
            exit 1
          fi

      - name: Validate Specification Document Structure
        run: |
          SPEC_FILE="docs/src/content/docs/reference/safe-inputs-specification.md"
          
          # Check file existence
          if [ ! -f "$SPEC_FILE" ]; then
            echo "::error::Specification file not found at $SPEC_FILE"
            exit 1
          fi

          # Check for W3C-style RFC 2119 keywords
          if ! grep -qE "(MUST|SHALL|SHOULD|MAY)" "$SPEC_FILE"; then
            echo "::error::Specification must contain RFC 2119 keywords (MUST/SHALL/SHOULD/MAY)"
            exit 1
          fi

          # Check for version 1.1.0
          if ! grep -q "1.1.0" "$SPEC_FILE"; then
            echo "::error::Specification must declare version 1.1.0"
            exit 1
          fi

          # Check for core sections (architecture, configuration, execution, etc.)
          REQUIRED_SECTIONS=("architecture" "configuration" "execution" "security" "mcp gateway")
          for section in "${REQUIRED_SECTIONS[@]}"; do
            if ! grep -qi "$section" "$SPEC_FILE"; then
              echo "::error::Specification missing required section: $section"
              exit 1
            fi
          done

          # Check for 48 compliance test cases
          TEST_COUNT=$(grep -c "T-[A-Z]*-[0-9]*" "$SPEC_FILE" || true)
          if [ "$TEST_COUNT" -lt 48 ]; then
            echo "::error::Specification must contain at least 48 compliance test cases. Found: $TEST_COUNT"
            exit 1
          fi

          # Check for specific test case categories
          if ! grep -q "T-DEP-" "$SPEC_FILE"; then
            echo "::error::Specification missing dependency management test cases (T-DEP-*)"
            exit 1
          fi
          
          if ! grep -q "T-SEC-" "$SPEC_FILE"; then
            echo "::error::Specification missing security test cases (T-SEC-*)"
            exit 1
          fi

      - name: Validate Schema Examples
        run: |
          SCHEMA_FILE="docs/public/schemas/safe-inputs-config.schema.json"
          
          # Check for 7 complete examples in schema
          EXAMPLE_COUNT=$(grep -c '"example"' "$SCHEMA_FILE" || true)
          if [ "$EXAMPLE_COUNT" -lt 7 ]; then
            echo "::error::Schema must contain at least 7 complete examples. Found: $EXAMPLE_COUNT"
            exit 1
          fi

          # Validate that examples cover all supported languages
          for lang in "shell" "python" "go" "javascript"; do
            if ! grep -qi "$lang" "$SCHEMA_FILE"; then
              echo "::error::Schema examples must cover $lang implementation"
              exit 1
            fi
          done

      - name: Check MCP Gateway Extensibility Support
        run: |
          SPEC_FILE="docs/src/content/docs/reference/safe-inputs-specification.md"
          
          # Verify MCP Gateway integration section exists
          if ! grep -qi "mcp gateway integration" "$SPEC_FILE"; then
            echo "::error::Specification must document MCP Gateway integration"
            exit 1
          fi

          # Verify custom server types support is documented
          if ! grep -qi "custom server types" "$SPEC_FILE"; then
            echo "::error::Specification must document support for custom server types"
            exit 1
          fi

      - name: Validate Security Model Documentation
        run: |
          SPEC_FILE="docs/src/content/docs/reference/safe-inputs-specification.md"
          
          # Check for security enhancements
          if ! grep -q "C.5" "$SPEC_FILE" || ! grep -q "dependency security" "$SPEC_FILE"; then
            echo "::error::Specification must include dependency security section (C.5)"
            exit 1
          fi

          if ! grep -q "C.6" "$SPEC_FILE" || ! grep -q "github actions integration security" "$SPEC_FILE"; then
            echo "::error::Specification must include GitHub Actions integration security section (C.6)"
            exit 1
          fi

      - name: Validate GitHub Actions Integration Example
        run: |
          SPEC_FILE="docs/src/content/docs/reference/safe-inputs-specification.md"
          
          # Check for Appendix A.5 with PR complexity analysis example
          if ! grep -q "Appendix A.5" "$SPEC_FILE"; then
            echo "::error::Specification must include Appendix A.5 with GitHub Actions integration example"
            exit 1
          fi

          if ! grep -q "PR complexity analysis" "$SPEC_FILE"; then
            echo "::error::Specification must demonstrate PR complexity analysis in GitHub Actions example"
            exit 1
          fi

      - name: Validate Error Handling Documentation
        run: |
          SPEC_FILE="docs/src/content/docs/reference/safe-inputs-specification.md"
          
          # Check for Appendix B.4 with dependency installation failure example
          if ! grep -q "Appendix B.4" "$SPEC_FILE"; then
            echo "::error::Specification must include Appendix B.4 with dependency installation failure example"
            exit 1
          fi

      - name: Validate Tool Name and Environment Variable Patterns
        run: |
          SPEC_FILE="docs/src/content/docs/reference/safe-inputs-specification.md"
          
          # Check for tool name regex pattern
          if ! grep -q '^\[a-zA-Z\]\[a-zA-Z0-9_-\]\*$' "$SPEC_FILE"; then
            echo "::error::Specification must document tool name validation pattern"
            exit 1
          fi

          # Check for environment variable validation
          if ! grep -q "uppercase alphanumeric with underscores" "$SPEC_FILE"; then
            echo "::error::Specification must document environment variable validation rules"
            exit 1
          fi

      - name: Validate Large Output Handling Documentation
        run: |
          SPEC_FILE="docs/src/content/docs/reference/safe-inputs-specification.md"
          
          # Check for 500 character threshold documentation
          if ! grep -q "500 character" "$SPEC_FILE"; then
            echo "::error::Specification must document 500 character threshold for large output handling"
            exit 1
          fi

          if ! grep -q "file storage" "$SPEC_FILE"; then
            echo "::error::Specification must document file storage mechanism for large outputs"
            exit 1
          fi

      - name: Validate Dependency Support Documentation
        run: |
          SPEC_FILE="docs/src/content/docs/reference/safe-inputs-specification.md"
          
          # Check for package manager detection documentation
          PACKAGE_MANAGERS=("npm" "pip" "go get" "apt" "yum")
          for pm in "${PACKAGE_MANAGERS[@]}"; do
            if ! grep -q "$pm" "$SPEC_FILE"; then
              echo "::error::Specification must document $pm package manager support"
              exit 1
            fi
          done

      - name: Validate JavaScript Global Objects Documentation
        run: |
          SPEC_FILE="docs/src/content/docs/reference/safe-inputs-specification.md"
          
          # Check for GitHub Actions global objects
          GLOBAL_OBJECTS=("github" "context" "core" "io" "exec" "glob" "artifact")
          for obj in "${GLOBAL_OBJECTS[@]}"; do
            if ! grep -q "$obj" "$SPEC_FILE"; then
              echo "::error::Specification must document $obj global object for JavaScript tools"
              exit 1
            fi
          done

      - name: Report Validation Results
        if: always()
        run: |
          echo "## Specification Validation Results" >> $GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY
          echo "" >> $GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY
          echo "- **Safe Inputs Specification**: Validated W3C-compliant structure with RFC 2119 keywords" >> $GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY
          echo "- **JSON Schema**: Validated Draft 7 compliance with 7+ examples" >> $GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY
          echo "- **Test Cases**: Verified 48+ compliance test cases across 7 categories" >> $GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY
          echo "- **Security**: Validated dependency and GitHub Actions integration security sections" >> $GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY
          echo "- **MCP Gateway**: Confirmed extensibility support for custom server types" >> $GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY
          echo "- **GitHub Actions Integration**: Validated comprehensive example with PR complexity analysis" >> $GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY
```
